decisions.reason: The accelerator program is shown prominently on the home page and publicly ties the firm to its circular-economy mission, so dropping it would expose an announced commitment, though its low capital investment and distance from core machinery make it somewhat vulnerable.

The CO2-negative bitumen binder still has a dedicated page and reflects R&D investment the firm has to justify, and its slow traction can be blamed on long material-certification cycles, so management persists despite its distance from the core business.

The infectious waste decontamination plant carries heavy investment, a public partnership with ERMAFA and home-page prominence as the 'start' of its range, so management is strongly committed to it and will attribute any slow sales to temporary market-entry causes.
